methods.label: Use logarithm rules
methods.explanation:
Here \(\log\) denotes the common logarithm, with base \(10\). To express the answer using \(\log2\), write \(125=(10/2)^3\). The power and quotient rules give
\[
\begin{aligned}
\log125
&=3\log\left(\frac{10}{2}\right)\\
&=3(\log10-\log2)\\
&=\boxed{3-3\log2},
\end{aligned}
\]
since \(\log10=1\). The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
